text: Enterprise Holdings was created in 2009 as a holding company for the Taylor family's growing portfolio of car rental and transportation services; the Enterprise, National and Alamo brands all fall under this company.
short: Enterprise Rent-A-Car sits under Enterprise Holdings, the Taylor family holding company

source.name: Enterprise Mobility: Our Heritage (company history page)
source.quote: Enterprise Holdings is created as a holding company for the Taylor family’s growing portfolio of car rental and transportation services. Enterprise, National and Alamo all fall under this company.
source.note: Same page: 'see how a family-owned organization has become a global mobility leader'; 2007 entry: 'the Taylor family acquires the National Car Rental and Alamo Rent a Car brands'.

additionalSources.name: OFCCP v. Enterprise RAC Company of Baltimore, LLC — ALJ Recommended Findings and Order, July 17, 2019 (copy hosted by Roffman Horvitz PLC), Conclusions of Law no. 3
additionalSources.quote: Enterprise is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Enterprise Holdings, Inc.
additionalSources.note: Stipulation of the parties in the DOL administrative case, tying the Enterprise car-rental subsidiary to Enterprise Holdings, Inc.
